purpose: Teach: パワフル/備わっ/チョイス/分量/健闘/切り離し/編著/有数

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、パワフルな実行力をお持ちだった
lines.en: Father had such powerful executive drive when he was starting out.
lines.style: Gentle, measured pace. Warm nostalgia in the voice. Each phrase lingers slightly, as if turning over a memory. Soft eye-contact level. Speaking to someone who would understand.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんには経営者の風格が備わってらした
lines.en: Yes. Father had real bearing as a business leader.
lines.style: Calm acknowledgment. Respectful tone, not deferential. A pause before speaking, as if gathering what matters to say. Steady delivery, grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、戦略のチョイスを的確になさった
lines.en: Father always made exactly the right strategic choices.
lines.style: Quieter, more distant. A slight waver—not sadness, but the weight of memory. Slow pace. Voice trails at the end, as if he's still watching those choices unfold.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは投資の分量を見極められた
lines.en: Yes. Father had such keen judgment about investment—knowing exactly how much to risk.
lines.style: Steady, reflective tone. Voice doesn't rush. A private moment of recognition. Careful, precise diction. Respect mixed with something like awe.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若手社員の健闘を信じてらした
lines.en: Father trusted the younger staff to fight and win their own battles.
lines.style: Softer, almost tender. A slight catch of emotion held steady. Slow, deliberate pacing. Voice warms on 'trusted'—that was the real gift.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは不採算部門を切り離しの決断もされた
lines.en: Yes. Father made the difficult decision to cut away the unprofitable divisions.
lines.style: Measured, grave. Voice carries the weight of understanding what that cost. Not heavy-handed, but honest. Slight pause before 'difficult,' as if acknowledging the burden of that choice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界誌の編著を任されてた
lines.en: Father was trusted to edit and contribute to the industry's leading publications.
lines.style: Warmth returns. Almost proud. Slower cadence, savouring the detail. Voice lifts slightly—not on display, but genuine appreciation for the recognition his father earned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが業界有数の経営者になった
lines.en: Yes. Father became one of the industry's most respected leaders.
lines.style: Voice settles into quiet certainty. A statement that closes something. Measured, final cadence. Pride without boasting. Tender gravity—as if he's just now fully seeing what his father became.
